result.title: $L_0$ Feature Selection via Monte Carlo Tree Search in High-Dimensional Financial Regression
result.comment: Accepted at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26). 8 pages, 2 figures
result.summary: Feature selection is a central problem in high-dimensional financial regression, where large numbers of engineered variables and strong correlations among predictors reduce model stability and interpretability. $L_1$ regularization (Lasso) is widely used for sparse regression, but its shrinkage can be restrictive when informative signals are spread across correlated variables. Exact sparse regression avoids this shrinkage but requires solving a combinatorial optimization problem that is computationally difficult and is typically fit to minimize in-sample rather than out-of-sample error. This paper presents a feature selection framework based on Monte Carlo Tree Search with Generalized Nested Rollout Policy Adaptation (GNRPA). Feature selection is formulated as a sequential decision process, and candidate subsets are scored by their out-of-sample validation performance rather than training error. The method also supports a lexicographic objective accounting for subset size and multicollinearity. We study this approach on a contemporaneous explanatory regression task: explaining the weekly return of the NASDAQ-100 index from 1,072 engineered features spanning market, macroeconomic, and factor data. This isolates the value of subset selection under multicollinearity from the separate problem of predictive forecasting. On this task, the proposed method identifies sparse feature subsets with higher out-of-sample explanatory power than an optimized Lasso baseline, reaching an out-of-sample $R^2$ of 0.6961 versus 0.6313 for Lasso. These results suggest that Monte Carlo Tree Search is a practical alternative to convex regularization for sparse explanatory feature selection in financial regression, with potential value for factor attribution and risk decomposition where transparency matters as much as out-of-sample fit.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将高维金融回归的特征选择建模为序贯决策过程，用蒙特卡洛树搜索结合 GNRPA 搜索稀疏特征子集，并以样本外验证表现而非训练误差作为打分准则，在 NASDAQ-100 周收益解释任务上优于 Lasso。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 MCTS＋rollout 策略自适应的序贯搜索与「以验证目标替代训练目标打分」的做法，可能为 latent 推理轨迹或视觉证据子集的搜索、以及何时停止扩展的决策提供方法线索，但金融回归与多模态推理的差距需核查。
